pretreatments.description: Concentrated phosphoric acid pretreatment (83-85.9% phosphoric acid, 50°C for 50 min, acetone precipitation, water washing, drying)
Organosolv pretreatment (75% ethanol, 150°C for 30 min, sulfuric acid catalyst, ethanol/water ratio 1:8, separation of solid and liquid phases, neutralization, drying)
Dilute sulfuric acid pretreatment (0.5% w/w, 140°C for 5 min, ice-water bath, separation of solid and liquid phases, neutralization, drying)
